legacy.opponent: maximum public type-adjusted base power baseline
legacy.note: Fixed synthetic matchup evaluation, not human ladder strength.

selected.opponent: maximum public type-adjusted base power baseline
selected.note: Fixed synthetic matchup evaluation, not human ladder strength.

inputSensitivity.note: Legal-candidate counterfactual sensitivity checks, not independent match wins.

limitations: Opponent speed is a public neutral-stat estimate; no hidden IV/EV/nature/item/ability access.
Fixed independent battles against a public-damage baseline are not human ladder or 27-fight campaign performance.
Fresh 54-game audit: 33 legacy wins, 32 selected wins. This does not establish a win-rate improvement.
Legacy checkpoints retain the v1 module and exact original model bytes until that encounter ends.
selection: Rejected fully updated candidates with lower development performance; freeze original 32 learned priors, fit 16 state/action interactions to public replays, then choose a conservative blend using development seeds 2000/4000. Fresh audit uses seeds 12000, shift 11.
